# Mehta Ventures Capital (Mehta VC)

> Mehta Ventures Capital is an investment firm backing ambitious founders, emerging technologies and innovative businesses shaping tomorrow.

## About

Mehta Ventures Capital focuses on people with conviction, ideas that challenge convention, and technology that moves the world forward.

The firm's investment interests include technology, artificial intelligence and innovative businesses.

Official website: https://vcmehta.com/
